summary: Fastidious demonstrates how a free-to-play account can amass roughly 300 premium summons within five days of starting. The strategy relies on strictly hoarding Heliolite Dice, blitzing the Season Journey chapters for milestone rewards, and taking advantage of daily discounted Wyrmarrow packs. He also explains how banner summon rebates reduce the true 300-pull guarantee cost down to 270 dice. After hitting the guarantee on the Reversal Summon banner, he pulls Child of Chaos along with multiple other legendaries, emphasizing the value of saving until guarantees can be reached.

tips: Never pull on premium rate-up banners unless you have enough resources saved to hit the guaranteed milestone.
Factor in banner rebates when calculating summon counts: pulling 200 times refunds 30 Heliolite Dice (5 at 50, 10 at 100, 15 at 200), dropping a 300-pull requirement down to 270 upfront dice.
Prioritize completing Season Journey chapters in order; each chapter awards 5 Heliolite Dice and accelerates account progression.
Buy the daily 10-dice bundle from Wyrmarrow Supply for 800 Wyrmarrow instead of 1000 to save 200 Wyrmarrow per day.
Claim the 2 free Heliolite Dice daily from the Heliolithic Present event during your first seven days.
Spend all excess stamina/bread in the highest unlocked stage of Goblin Lair to farm EXP and push Resonance Level, which strengthens the entire roster simultaneously.
title: How To Get A PREMIUM Legendary Hero In Less Than 5 Days ⁂ Dragonheir: Silent Gods
